title: The Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale, Depth, and Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. translated_title: 跨规模、深度与指令微调的情绪表示几何学研究
translated_abstract: 我们测量了涵盖Google Gemma 2系列的六个大语言模型的情绪几何结构。使用由Sofroniew等人（2026）在Claude Sonnet 4.5上建立、并由Hollowell（2026）在Gemma 2 27B基础模型上复现的提取流程，我们比较了Gemma 2 2B、9B和27B的基础版与指令微调变体之间的情绪几何结构。首先，所有六个模型单元都表现出核心的情绪几何结构。在两个模型单元之间拟合的线性映射能够将留出的情绪定位到目标模型中最接近其自身向量的位置。在全部十五个模型对（每个方向各拟合一次）中，该方法仅失败一次，且每个模型对的中位排名均为1。在清洗后的嵌入表向量上重新拟合的线性映射，在全部三十个有序模型对中都能以排名1恢复每一个留出的情绪。其次，规模扩大使几何结构的方差分布在更多方向上，同时并未削弱其与情绪效价的联系。主成分的方差占比从31.6%（2B）降至29.8%（9B）再到26.7%（27B），
tldr: 该研究证明Gemma 2系列从2B到27B、无论基础版还是指令微调版的大语言模型均共享一种可通过线性映射相互转换的核心情绪几何结构，且模型规模扩大使该几何结构方差分布于更多方向但仍保持与情绪效价的紧密关联。
en_tdlr: LLMs across the Gemma 2 family—from 2B to 27B, in both base and instruction-tuned variants—share a core emotion geometry recoverable via linear mapping between models, and scaling spreads this geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to emotional valence.
